simple.summary: בֻּקִּיָּה (Buqqîyâh) means Bukkijah , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 25 4.

definitions.full: H1232. Buqqiyyahu בֻּקִּיָּ֫הוּ proper name, masculine ( proved of ׳י ) Levite, son of Heman 1Chr 25:4 ; son of Asaph (?) 25:13 .
